shared_or_similar_visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It represents the hidden rear bottom edge DC of the prism. Right image: It is a horizontal reference line through the wave, rather than the wave curve itself.
Rationales: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The right horizontal dashes run across the wave as a plotting reference rather than tracing a hidden object boundary. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
